Docket 1.3.111

**Docket is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes), $349, or 4 payments of $87.25, to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *One dead site no longer holds up your audit.* After the crawl, Docket checks the links your
  site makes to other sites. It used to wait for every one it had started, so a single site that
  never answered could hold the audit for about forty seconds in our test, and the link it was
  waiting on was then reported as broken. That stage now has a limit of ten seconds from when it
  starts. A link that has not answered by then is left out of the results instead of being called
  dead, and the finding and the report say how many links were not checked in time.

99 checks across 13 areas.
